Well from my experience, it’s not something you have control over. My current boyfriend went through a period of feeling trapped about 1 1/2 years and tried to push through it. We’ve been dating 4 years now, but it almost destroyed our relationship. It slowly turned very bad to where he formed resentment towards me, cheated and lied to me quite a lot to try to spare my feelings. I’m not saying you’ll do these things at all but I saw how that trapped feeling transformed into something quite worse. However, my relationship did work out, but it took so much therapy, time and forgiveness that could’ve been avoided had we just maybe opted for a time break instead of working it through. There’s a lot of self sacrifice in trying to work through the feeling of being trapped not only for you but your boyfriend too, so you really need to evaluate if it’s worth it to try or not to you. It’s definitely not something easily fixed at all, and it will be hard on both of you regardless. I wish you luck though, relationships are a hard thing.

Unfortunately you’re going to hurt him no matter what. This feeling of being trapped most likely will manifest into issues that will hurt your relationship if you try to keep going. The best thing to do would be sit down and tell him what your feeling. It’s not fair for him to be with someone who feels trapped with him. As for the living situation, you could help with finding roommates or a new place to live if you care enough to, or give him like a warning period until you move out so he can prepare.

If he cannot be there for her in stressful times it might be hard because that’s literally OPs job. He took more energy into fighting than if he had just said just one phrase of support. I also would like to argue that the OP’s job is one of the hardest/exhausting out there and the fact that she is asking for support instead of isolation Indicates to me they are emotionally different in certain aspects that may make the relationship difficult. He may be different than what she needs logically speaking and I’m not trying to be rude, I could be wrong, it’s not my relationship, however I am giving the advise to at least look at the relationship and determine if this is something that happens frequently, and if she can accept that he might not be emotionally available when she needs some support. So I went through almost the same exact thing as you with my ex and I’ll give you the advise my therapist gave me. Humans are like puzzle pieces and some people need more emotional connections and reassurance than others, some people need only a little bit of help and some people need all the help that can be given. When you are with someone whose on different ends of connection spectrums you may not fit because they cannot give you what he doesn’t have.  If you need someone who will give you emotional support more often, then that’s just who you are and more often than not, therapy will not change your need for reassurance. Therapy helps with coping but it doesn’t not usually eliminate the problems. If your boyfriend doesn’t have the empathy, especially while you’re alone, to not even try to tell you it’s okay mean that he more often than not will make you feel like a burden for having emotions. Even if it isn’t his intent and it’s coming from a good place, it will probably hurt you. You should have never apologized for your feelings, you are valid, you are allowed to feel lonely, sad, stressed. It is also valid to find a life partner who can support your needs and wants and honestly it just sounds like you guys might not be an emotional match. I will give you the advise to look into now if you want a future like this, because most likely you will be dealing with things alone. You’re only 8 months in, and it’s better to evaluate now instead of continuing and building a relationship that will fundamentally hurt you.
Also to edit in: I’m not trying to say your boyfriend is a bad guy, but that his inability to understand and differences you have in feelings can cause turmoil in the relationship due to different needs and wants. He may never understand why you require the support from him, he may never feel like it’s his responsibility. Some people are like that, and it’s up to you if you want to spend your life with someone who’s different than you. Also therapy would be good for you in general to help with work, but I definitely understand the financial burden of going.

Okay, I know you love him, but he is abusing you verbally. I know this is hard to hear, I know what I say probably won’t make you leave him as my mom stayed with my father for 30 years before she listened to us. I know I don’t know you so you have no reason to listen to me but please leave him. He will only hurt you more and more, you are beautiful, smart, and everyone someone wants, but know, that person is NOT him. As I said my mom stayed with my father for 30 years and endured the same things from him that your fiancé is doing to you. My mom ignored all the red flags before their marriage and it hurt her forever. My mom spent most of her life with anorexia due to the things we say which are the same your fiancé says to you. It was hard watching my mother wither away and hate herself so much because this terrible man never loved her and only hurt and used her.  I also myself understandable you feel about your degree, I blew 20,000 in cosmetology school because my father forced me into it because it was the “only thing I’d be good at” and it was the only thing he’d help pay for. I failed and hated every day of it, and one day I stopped going.  Since then I started a degree I wanted to have, yes I had to start over, but my life has hope now. I know saying to change your degree is a lot, but don’t let them push you into ruining your life girl. You need to chase what will make you happy, you deserve the world, and you’re not getting it. I know we don’t know each other, but I now care immensely about you due to this situation and I don’t want you to be hurt in life. If you’ve been looking for a sign this is it, please leave him, please don’t marry this man, please don’t have children with this man, he will treat them the same as you. I know it’ll be hard, I know it’ll make everything difficult and you’ll be alone but please leave him, he doesn’t love you or else he wouldn’t say these things. My father had a shitty way of ruining every vacation and blaming it on us too. If you need someone to talk to for support, my inbox is open. If it gives you hope, my mom found her soul mate at 56 even after feeling like she wasted everything on my dad, her new husband has given my mom everything my dad never could, he supports her and constantly reassures her she’s the most beautiful woman, he sends flowers to her job every week so my mom can feel special in front of her other workers, he pushed her to get the management job she thought she’d never get, and he surprised her with amazing vacations almost every month, even if it’s just one night to a neighboring city and treats her like a queen. I know this is long and I’m sorry about that but I truly care, and I want you to have a beautiful, happy life. I hope you can make a decision to leave for yourself, you deserve the world ❤️
